name: dev-hooks
description: Polyglot dev-workflow hooks for Claude Code.

plugins.name: dev-hooks
plugins.description: Auto-lint files on edit, verify tests/linters before stopping, stack-aware skill reminders on session start, multi-session plan reminders, and end-of-session memory-capture reminders — plus thinking-tool skills (but-for-real, premortem, board, self-rate, weekly-automation-review) and writing/content and secrets-workflow skills adapted from Nate Berkopec's dotfiles (github-readme, humanizer, readability, env-to-fnox).
